important caveat: this is a very new, self-published/theoretical work, not an established
academic framework, so the concepts below are best understood as the author's proposed
model rather than settled terminology.

captures.description: THE TERM, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31, the Overview expanded: 'Autonomous semantic warfare is an emergent form of conflict where artificial intelligence agents independently generate and manipulate narratives, data streams, and communication networks.' Three core components (agentic AI influence; speed of command and data compression; 'Ontological and Structural Collisions: Frameworks like Autonomous Semantic Warfare: A Field Manual for Meaning in the Age of Platform Capture by Rex Fraction analyze how networked platforms extract meaning-production capacity from users, turning communication spaces into structured battlegrounds of incompatible worldviews'), strategic and military integration. Eight cards: Amazon (the manual), INSS, Homeland Security Today, the registry's capture page of 2026-06-15, the Scandinavian Journal of Military Studies, two videos.

inversions.against: The set's inversion guidance: "'warfare' read as military activity drops the frame"; the manual's own claim boundary: 'a formal and practical account of conflict among local ontologies under platform capture'; #100: ASW operates 'not through deception, kinetic force, or direct cognitive manipulation, but through ordinary infrastructure operations'.
